summary: Consolidated Edison filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an equity distribution agreement with multiple agents, establishing an at-the-market (ATM) offering program for up to $2 billion of common shares. The program includes forward sale agreements allowing forward purchasers to borrow and sell shares, with proceeds received only upon physical settlement at the company’s option. No price per share, premium, or specific date is stated; terms are open-ended. The filing is a routine capital markets financing arrangement, not a special situation. This ATM program is a standard shelf takedown mechanism, not an event-driven transaction.
